summary: Tested the staging seed script and the Stripe/PayPal payment flows on the preview URL. SEED SCRIPT: all checks pass. `--reset --allow-localhost` exits 0 and prints READY with every OK line. A second run without --reset stays idempotent (9 jobs, 7 users, 1 coupon, no duplicate titles). `--check` leaves the DB unchanged (md5 of all collections is the same before and after). 13 guard cases exit 2 and change nothing: prod db name, localhost without the flag, STAGING_MONGO_HOST mismatch, a@staging.test, weak staff password, STRIPE_MODE=live, duplicate email (also with different case), preview host, a non-staging host, missing URL, and 'latestdb' (substring is not a marker). With a custom STAGING_CREW2_EMAIL the Drywall in_progress job is assigned to that account. A temporary uvicorn on port 8765 against the staging DB accepted POST /api/auth/login for all 7 seeded accounts (old testcrew2 got 401 as expected). The API was stopped and the *_qa DB dropped. The existing unit tests pass (50 passed, 1 skipped). STRIPE: these flows were paid with the 4242 test card and then confirmed: (1) Crew subscription through the real UI. crew_monthly plus TEST20 shows 'Pay $15.99', the Stripe page shows US$15.99, the redirect to /subscription?session_id&method=stripe shows the 'Payment confirmed' toast and then goes to /crew/dashboard. subscription/status is active, plan crew_monthly, 29 days. The transaction has amount 15.99, original 19.99, paid. Coupon usage_count was incremented once. Repeat status calls return already_processed true with no extra days. Another user gets 404. (2) Verified contractor fee for a new contractor: session created, US$39.99, paid, status gives paid then already_processed, is_verified_contractor=true for 1 year, other user gets 404. (3) Job boost via API: US$9.99, paid, the status endpoint sets is_featured and boost_expires_at +7 days, the repeat call is idempotent. (4) Job boost through the real UI as contractor2 (BoostJobModal, pay, redirect): FAILS. The job is NOT featured and the transaction stays pending (see the critical issue). Contact unlock: session creation and the unpaid status ('unpaid', nothing granted) were checked; it was not paid. Security checks pass: an unpaid status grants nothing, the webhook returns 503 'Stripe webhook is not configured', a fake signature is rejected, a crew account buying contractor_pro gets 400, an invalid plan or coupon gets 400, an unauthenticated call is rejected, boosting someone else's job gets 403, a missing job gets 404, a verified contractor re-buying gets 400, crew buying verification gets 403. PAYPAL: untestable for real here (no credentials). The graceful handling works: create-order and boost/paypal return 503 'PayPal is not configured', capture of an unknown order returns 404, the webhook returns 503 'PayPal webhook is not configured'. In the UI, choosing PayPal shows paypal-unavailable, and switch-to-stripe-btn brings back the card checkout.

critical.issue: A paid boost done through the UI is never fulfilled unless the Stripe webhook is configured. success_url is /contractor/dashboard?boost_success=1&job_id=... with no {CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}. ContractorDashboard has no boost_success handler and never calls /boost/stripe/status. Reproduced: contractor2 paid $9.99 with 4242, was redirected, saw no toast and made no status call, and the job stayed is_featured=false with the tx still pending. STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset, so the webhook fails closed with 503. I recovered it by calling the status endpoint by hand.

minor.issue: origin_url is used without the _origin() allow-list, which only contact-unlock and guest-job use. I passed https://evil.example.com and got a valid checkout session, so after paying the user is redirected to an attacker domain (open redirect / phishing). Use _origin(request, body) everywhere.
`await request.json()` with no body returns 500 Internal Server Error. Use the guarded pattern from contact-unlock.

Changing plan resets subscription_end to now+days. testcrew had crew_annual until 2027-10-23, bought crew_monthly, and now ends 2026-11-22, so about 11 months of paid time were lost. This needs a business decision (prorate, stack, or block downgrades).

Admins may create a boost for another contractor's job, but the tx user_id is the admin and _fulfill_boost_tx requires contractor_id == tx.user_id. That raises RuntimeError, so the boost is never applied after an admin pays.
Unlike the webhook path, the polling path does not call _transaction_amount_matches. The risk is low because the amount is set by the server, but the two paths are inconsistent.

The staff password strength check runs in ensure_staff after server.startup_event() has already written indexes, settings, trades and the super admin. On a fresh DB a weak ADMIN password exits 2 but leaves a partly seeded DB (16 collections, 1 user). Validate all passwords in resolve_accounts before touching the DB.
The `existing` pending-transaction lookup is computed but never used (dead code; there is no duplicate-session prevention as the comment claims).

ui_bugs.issue: The status endpoint is called twice after the redirect. The useEffect re-runs when refreshUser changes user, so verifyStripe is recreated. The result is two 'Payment confirmed!' toasts. It is harmless on the backend (the second call returns already_processed).
There is a single check with no polling and the catch is silent. If Stripe reports unpaid or processing at first, the user sees nothing and gets no retry.

integration_issues.issue: No confirmation after returning from Stripe and the job is never featured (see backend critical).

issues: Shows the raw label 'Crew_monthly Plan' instead of the plan label 'Crew Monthly'

action_items: HIGH: Fix the boost return flow. Add session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID} to the boost success_url and add a ContractorDashboard effect that polls /payments/boost/stripe/status/{sid} and then refreshes jobs and shows a toast (same pattern as verified_session_id).
Validate origin_url with _origin() in all Stripe/PayPal session-creation endpoints.
Guard request.json() in the boost and verified-contractor endpoints (empty body currently returns 500).
Decide the plan-switch behaviour in update_subscription (remaining paid time is lost today).
In seed_staging.py, validate staff passwords before startup_event writes to the DB.
Deduplicate verifyStripe calls and toast on SubscriptionPage; add short polling.
Production needs STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET and PayPal credentials plus a webhook id; real PayPal sandbox flow remains untested.
critical_code_review_comments: fulfill_subscription_tx uses an atomic find_one_and_update on payment_status != paid. Idempotency was confirmed in practice (no double extension, coupon usage +1 only).
get_owned_tx plus the metadata user_id check stops cross-user status reads (verified 404).
payment_routes.py is 1209 lines; split into stripe/paypal/boost/verified/guest modules.
The seed script guards are solid. The STAGE_MARKER regex correctly rejects substrings like 'latestdb'.

success_rate.backend: 18/18 API tests pass + 15/15 seed-script checks + 50 unit tests; 1 HIGH integration bug (boost return flow)
success_rate.frontend: Subscription Stripe flow and PayPal fallback pass; boost UI flow fails to fulfil

The TEST20 usage_count is 1. Several unpaid pending session transactions remain. The temporary contractor test_iter8_contractor@example.com and its transactions were deleted. daylaborcrew_staging_qa and dlc_weak_staging_qa were dropped.

Stripe hosted checkout field ids: #email #cardNumber #cardExpiry #cardCvc #billingName #billingPostalCode, submit [data-testid=hosted-payment-submit-button]. sk_test_emergent cannot be used with the stripe SDK directly; the amount was confirmed from the hosted page text. To retest the boost fix: log in as contractor2 or 3, click [data-testid^=boost-job-], then boost-confirm-btn, pay, and expect a status call and is_featured=true.
rca of the issue: Boost: the boost_job_stripe success_url omits {CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID} and ContractorDashboard has no boost_success handler, so the client-side confirmation path never runs. Fulfilment depends only on the webhook, which correctly fails closed (503) without STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Reproduce: contractor2 dashboard, Boost, Stripe, pay with 4242; the job stays unfeatured and the tx stays pending. Fix: add session_id to success_url and poll the status endpoint on return.
